newsitem.title: USA: ARV sees oper losses in next 3 qtrs.
newsitem.headline: ARV sees oper losses in next 3 qtrs.

text.p: ARV Assisted Living Inc said early Friday that it expects to post operating losses in the first three quarters of the fiscal year ending March 31, 1998.
The company attributed the losses to projected start-up costs associated with newly-developed assisted living facilities.
ARV said it also is searching for a chief operating officer to assist management and to direct its efforts to improvements in facility operations.
The company said it also is continuing to reposition several of the 14 assets acquired from third parties in the past 16 months.

"While we have grown and attained a significant critical mass through the acquisition of facilities, we have found that repositioning of several of the acquired assets has taken longer than expected," President and Chief Executive Gary Davidson said in a statement. "Moreover, the market for acquisitions has tightened with prices increasing to levels that have reduced discounts to replacement cost."
